stemMd: What is the negation of "Some archived files are encrypted"?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Exactly one archived file is encrypted.

explanationMd: The existential claim fails precisely when there is no archived file with encryption. This is equivalent to every archived file being unencrypted.

distractorRationale.e: A minority could still be encrypted.
distractorRationale.c: This is a special case of the original assertion.
distractorRationale.a: This can coexist with some encrypted files.
distractorRationale.d: This normally supports the original statement if files exist.
